description: NaLa(GaS₂)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.20 Å. There are two inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are four shorter (3.02 Å) and four longer (3.05 Å) La-S bond lengths. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are four shorter (3.03 Å) and four longer (3.05 Å) La-S bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing GaS₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.32 Å) Ga-S bond lengths. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to four S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing GaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-S bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.33 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to one Na, one La, and two Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNaLaGa₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded to one Na, one La, and two Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNaLaGa₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded to one Na, one La, and two equivalent Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNaLaGa₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one La, and two equivalent Ga atoms.
